steps.checkEn: Can draw and explain the causal chain.

steps.title: 手法要領與原理
steps.titleEn: Essentials and principles of the technique
steps.objective: 理解按法的動作結構、作用部位與功效。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand the movement structure, target region and effect of Pressing.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅示範後整理：指按、掌按與肘按；用於腧穴與肌肉。

steps.observationEn: Describe the start, point of force and finish.

steps.failureEn: Brute force instead of technique injures both practitioner and recipient.

steps.objective: 理解自我按摩與保健推拿的動作結構、作用部位與功效。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand the movement structure, target region and effect of Self-massage and health-maintenance tuina.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅示範後整理：眼保健操、梳頭、搓腰、揉腹。
steps.instructionEn: After the master's demonstration, organise: Eye exercises, hair combing, waist rubbing and abdominal kneading.
steps.observation: 口述手法的起勢、著力點與結束。
steps.observationEn: Describe the start, point of force and finish.
steps.failure: 用蠻力代替技巧會傷害施術者與受術者。
steps.failureEn: Brute force instead of technique injures both practitioner and recipient.
steps.check: 能說明手法的五要求（持久、有力、均勻、柔和、深透）如何體現。
steps.checkEn: Can explain how the five qualities (persistent, forceful, even, gentle, penetrating) apply.

knowledge.title: 作用機制
knowledge.text: 手法透過機械刺激影響肌筋膜、循環與神經反射。
knowledge.textEn: Manual techniques act through mechanical stimulation of myofascia, circulation and neural reflexes.

quiz.question: 「手法要領與原理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Essentials and principles of the technique'?
options: 能說明手法的五要求（持久、有力、均勻、柔和、深透）如何體現。
紀錄完整且能說出三項禁忌。
已正確完成「梳頭」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「眼保健操」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Can explain how the five qualities (persistent, forceful, even, gentle, penetrating) apply.
Record complete and three contraindications named.
'hair combing' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'Eye exercises' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 施術者姿勢與安全溝通
steps.objective: 建立正確站姿、重心與受術者溝通。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish stance, centre of gravity and communication with the recipient.
steps.instruction: 確認禁忌（骨折、血栓、感染、懷孕、植入物）、告知力度並取得同意。
steps.instructionEn: Screen contraindications (fracture, thrombosis, infection, pregnancy, implants), explain pressure and obtain consent.
steps.observationEn: Record the recipient's feedback.
steps.failure: 忽略禁忌是推拿事故的主因。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring contraindications is the main cause of manual-therapy accidents.
steps.check: 完成安全篩檢與同意。
steps.checkEn: Safety screening and consent complete.

knowledge.title: 人體力學
knowledge.text: 以體重與下肢驅動，保護施術者的腕與腰。
knowledge.textEn: Drive with body weight and legs to protect the practitioner's wrists and back.

能說明手法的五要求（持久、有力、均勻、柔和、深透）如何體現。
完成安全篩檢與同意。
optionsEn: Sequence is sound and includes assessment and reassessment.
'hair combing' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can explain how the five qualities (persistent, forceful, even, gentle, penetrating) apply.
Safety screening and consent complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.
